description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android TV application. It displays detailed information about a content item, including metadata, background, action buttons, and system date/time. It also handles user interactions through focus navigation and button clicks, including initiating a media playback request to an API endpoint.

classes.description: Main activity class displaying content details and handling user interactions.
